The malware attempted exfiltration to the domain data-exfil.evil.com. Although initial EDR and sandbox analysis failed to flag malicious behavior, further correlation revealed suspicious activity. The host was isolated via firewall block, and a subsequent full EPP scan detected Miner.CoinHive.A. No evidence of lateral movement or data exfiltration was confirmed. Root cause appears to be a phishing compromise.

IOC lookup on data-exfil.evil.com returns prior IDS alert for port scan from external IP, but no direct correlation to internal assets at the time.
SIEM search reveals 23 DNS queries to data-exfil.evil.com over the past 24 hours from 10.0.6.88. No prior alerts were generated for this activity.
Sandbox re-analysis of the malware sample confirms file enumeration of financial records and beaconing behavior. Initial 'clean' verdict was incorrect due to evasion techniques.
Firewall rule deployed to block outbound traffic from 10.0.6.88.
Full EPP scan of 10.0.6.88 detects and quarantines Miner.CoinHive.A in /tmp/.x11-lock.
Incident response actions completed. Endpoint pending full forensic imaging and user re-education.

arguments.summary: An APT intrusion was detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to user CORP\jsmith. The compromise began with a phishing-induced PowerShell execution from Outlook, leading to Cobalt Strike beaconing via rundll32.exe. Lateral movement was attempted via SMB to 10.0.3.10. The source IP 10.0.5.42 has been blocked at the firewall, and a critical exploit (CVE-2024-3094) was detected in a system library during EPP scan. No malicious payload was confirmed in sandboxed artifacts, but behavioral indicators confirm compromise.

timeline.description: Initial Nmap scan activity detected from 10.0.8.200 targeting internal segment. CORP\jsmith linked via source identity.
User CORP\jsmith logs in to WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42). Outlook.exe launched.
Encoded PowerShell executed from Outlook (T1566.001). Likely phishing payload activation.
rundll32.exe loads unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory (T1218.011).
IDS alerts on Cobalt Strike beacon C2 traffic to 198.51.100.23 (T1071.001).
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042 (possible credential brute-force or AS-REP roast attempt).
SMB access to file server 10.0.5.50 detected (T1021.002). Lateral movement confirmed.
Incident escalated to SOC for ongoing monitoring and response.
Firewall rule FW-RULE-0009 implemented to block outbound traffic from 10.0.5.42.
Full EPP scan detects exploit.CVE-2024-3094 in /usr/lib/liblzma.so.5 on WS-FIN-042.
